description: USD spot prices for up to 20 symbols (BTC, ETH, SOL...) from Coinbase, with the source of each price. A Solana mint address also works and is priced by Jupiter. Symbols without a price are listed in unavailable. Cached 15 seconds. Information only, not financial advice. Related tools on this server, for a different need: crypto_candles when you need OHLCV candles for a Coinbase trading pair at 1m, 5m, 15m; crypto_convert when you need to convert crypto and fiat amounts at the current spot rate. Price: $0.002 in USDC per successful call, paid with x402 (Base, Solana or Arc); failed calls are not charged.

symbols.description: Comma-separated symbols (BTC,ETH) or Solana mint addresses, up to 20
